title: Cut Susi 0.21.48: bump the engine version and hand the tagged build to release.yml
goal: Release the 142 commits merged to main since v0.21.47 as 0.21.48. Bump the seven engine-version manifests, Cargo.lock, the README badge and the three governance ledgers together, matching the v0.21.47 bump (b78592dc6). Once the bump merges, the merge bot tags v0.21.48 (scripts/release-tag-merged-bump.sh) and dispatches release.yml, which runs the tagged suite and publishes the windows-x86_64 and linux-x86_64 binaries. Installed Windows production promotion is a separate, evidence-gated step and is not claimed by this cut.
